name: @pipeworx/mcp-censys

tools.name: censys_host
tools.description: What services, ports, and software are on IP <ip> — returns Censys internet-scan detail for a single host: open services (port/protocol/transport), software, location, and autonomous system. Example: censys_host({ ip: "8.8.8.8", _apiKey: "your-censys-token" })

ip.description: The IPv4/IPv6 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8"

_apiKey.description: Censys Platform Personal Access Token from platform.censys.io (API Access → Create New Token). Optionally "<token>:<organizationId>" to select a specific org.

tools.name: censys_host_search
tools.description: Search Censys hosts for <query> — finds internet-facing hosts matching a Censys query (CenQL), e.g. software, port, product, or ASN. Returns ip, matched services (port/service/transport), location, and autonomous system per host. Example: censys_host_search({ q: "services.service_name: HTTP and location.country: Germany", per_page: 25, _apiKey: "your-censys-token" })

_apiKey.description: Censys Platform Personal Access Token. Optionally "<token>:<organizationId>".

tools.name: censys_cert_search
tools.description: Search certificates for <domain> — searches Censys's certificate-transparency dataset by domain, SAN, or SHA-256 fingerprint. Returns fingerprint, names (SANs), issuer, and validity window per certificate. Example: censys_cert_search({ q: "names: example.com", per_page: 25, _apiKey: "your-censys-token" })

q.description: Censys certificate query (CenQL), e.g. "names: example.com", "parsed.issuer.organization: \"Let's Encrypt\"", or a SHA-256 fingerprint

_apiKey.description: Censys Platform Personal Access Token. Optionally "<token>:<organizationId>".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-censys forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the censys pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
